research_role: Building HVAC thermal load and environmental energy relationship modeling benchmark.
cold_chain_relevance: Analogue: Models facility HVAC energy driven by ambient temperature and occupancy. Useful to benchmark multi-factor thermal energy modeling, but does NOT represent cold room vapor-compression refrigeration.
notes: 1,000 hourly observations with HVACUsage, LightingUsage, SquareFootage, Occupancy, RenewableEnergy, DayOfWeek, and Holiday.
